title: Uwell Typhos Pro Pod Kit
description:
The
Uwell Typhos Pro Pod Kit
is a high-performance pod system with a massive 3000mAh battery, 1.47" HD colour display with dynamic UI themes, and up to 45W output. Features Storm and Waves modes, CoreShield anti-leak technology, and real dual mesh coils.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
3000mAh
Wattage Range:
18-45W
Charging:
USB Type-C (Fast Charge)
Activation:
Button + Draw-Activated
Display:
1.47" HD Colour Screen (Dynamic UI Themes)
E-Liquid Capacity:
6mL
Coil Resistance:
Integrated (Real Dual Mesh)
Airflow:
Stepless Adjustable (MTL to RDL)
Power Modes:
Storm Mode / Waves Mode
Pod Compatibility:
Uwell Typhos Pods (0.3Ω Dual Mesh, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω)
Brand:
Uwell
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
Available options: Midnight Black, Satin Silver.
